text:
Zoe: Quick idea — what if we add a "surface probe" action in Console to run a live-ish request through the rollout/fallback stack and show where it would route and which degrade mode would apply?
Nate: Interesting. Is this a dry-run or will it actually hit backends? We need to be careful about side effects.
Maria: Prefer dry-run that uses recorded routing/metrics to simulate. We could expose a toggle: "simulate vs replay". Simulate = no external effects, Replay = hits downstream with a test header.
Prashant: +1 for both. For Replay we should require a special test token and limit to dev/dedicated clusters. Prod replay is scary.
Zoe: UX idea: side-by-side panels: routing trace, predicted response (degraded if applicable), and audit log entry that would be created. Also show telemetry labels (fallback_reason, policy_id, sampled).
Nate: How do we surface quanta like latency budget and KV cache miss differences? Simulated latency will be approximate.
Maria: We can annotate results with confidence bands. Example: "predicted latency: 120-240ms (cache miss)".
Prashant: API debate: endpoint name: POST /policies/simulate vs /policies/preview vs /rollouts/trace. I vote /rollouts/simulate.
Zoe: API payload prototype:
```json
POST /rollouts/simulate
{ "policy_id": "p-123", "model": "gptx-7b", "input": "What's the weather?", "mode": "simulate" }
```
Nate: Response should include audit stub id so ops can reference it: { "audit_id": "a-789", "routing": [...], "degrade_mode": "soft-degrade", "predicted_response": "..." }
Maria: Security note: don't include sensitive prompt text in shared logs. We should mask or require explicit consent for storing payloads in audit trail.
Prashant: Telemetry tagging: add "simulate=true" and special sampling so these traces don't pollute alerting.
Zoe: @dev-platform can we add a small banner in Console: "Simulation results are approximate. Use Replay only for isolated test clusters." :warning:
dev-platform: Yup. We can add copy and a CTA to request Replay access for a team. Also will add RBAC check for Replay endpoints.
audit-bot: Audit stub created: a-789-sim  (simulated)  — retention: 30d. Use /audit/a-789-sim to view trace.
Nate: Edge case: model variants/quantized fallbacks might produce different semantic outputs. We should clearly mark cases where fallback switches model family.
Maria: Agreed. Add an explicit "model_families_changed": true field and show side-by-side outputs.
Zoe: Next steps: design mock for Console panel + API contract finalization. Volunteers for API review?
Prashant: I'll take API doc PR.
Nate: I'll mock the Console panel in Figma.
Maria: I'll write the telemetry + audit spec.
Zoe: Sweet. I'll slot a sync next Wed 10am. Thanks all :thumbsup:
